 ROCHESTER, Ind. (WSBT) — A 79-year-old Rochester woman faces charges for check fraud 20 years after the incident.
 Judith Michael was arrested Tuesday night after she was pulled over in Warsaw.
 The officer found out she had an arrest warrant out for her in Montgomery County, which is about an hour northwest of Indianapolis.
 The fraud case goes back to 2006, when a couple says Michael wrote a check for $37 to put gas in her car.
 She spent the night in the Warsaw Jail before being taken to Crawfordsville.
